question_text: Describe how you diagnose a network experiencing random widespread outages.
expected_answer: You check core switch logs analyze routing stability inspect spanning tree events and test for hardware faults

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot asymmetric routing in a complex network.
expected_answer: You trace packet paths review routing tables inspect firewall rules and correct mismatched route advertisements

question_text: Describe how you identify a failing core switch.
expected_answer: You monitor CPU spikes check error counters review logs for instability and test redundancy failover behavior

question_text: Explain how you diagnose severe latency affecting multiple VLANs.
expected_answer: You inspect interVLAN routing measure congestion analyze switch performance and verify trunk configurations

question_text: Describe how you troubleshoot intermittent packet corruption.
expected_answer: You test cable integrity monitor interface errors inspect transceivers and verify switch backplane health

question_text: Explain how you identify a misconfigured spanning tree environment.
expected_answer: You review root bridge selection inspect port roles check for loops and validate priority settings

question_text: Describe how you diagnose a firewall causing inconsistent traffic drops.
expected_answer: You inspect rule processing monitor logs test session limits and verify NAT or inspection behavior

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot BGP instability.
expected_answer: You check peer reachability review route flapping inspect timers and validate prefix filtering

question_text: Describe how you identify a failing network segment in a large topology.
expected_answer: You isolate segments test hop by hop monitor error rates and compare performance across paths

question_text: Explain how you diagnose multicast issues in an enterprise network.
expected_answer: You inspect IGMP behavior verify PIM configuration check rendezvous points and test group propagation
